translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus me Rhooapwuton Samaria we
Pharisees kkewe ra rongorong pwe ra towunap rhooan kkayeo kka Jesus a paptismusaar me mmwaen John nge a pwigiir pwe naiun rhooan kkayeo. (
Nge minna wenewenen, nge saapw Jesus pwe faer rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun minne re paptismusaar.)
Iwe nge igiwe Jesus a rongorong meeta we re aepesa, a siusaengi Judea a sefaaen ngaeni Galilee;
nge noan faaeraeg noa we aan nge epwan toonong noan Samaria.
Noan Samaria a noa reen eew aepinoamw itan Sychar, igaan nge ese taaw saengi maat we Jacob e ngaenneei Joseph iwe naiun.
Rhanniunim we aaen Jacob eno ee, iwe Jesus a itto mooat tiw epwe a mmaniuniu reen aan aeggaesaeisaei. A aerepa nugunupaen oanowas.
Erhai rhooapwuton Samaria a itto pwe epwe itto ifiif rhan, nge Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Ngoatto egius rhan pwe iuniumaei.” (
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun re soano pwe renoa nee aepinoamw pwe renoa chuwaai mwongo.)

Rhooapwut we a aengaeni pwe, “Een erhai Jew, nge ngaang erhai re Samaria — e ifa wusun nge wa tingoareaei iuniumoamw rhaan?” (Re Jews resoapw iun nong noan aar kkap me mwongo nong noan aar saepiy re Samaria.)
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Aere wo giuneei meeta e Deus efang me iyo e etingoareog iuniuman rhaan, nge wo tingoar ngaeni nge iiy epwe ngaenneog minna rhaniun menaw.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Menap, esooar oamw pwaecchi nge rhanniunim een iye e igin nennoan. Iya iga wopwe pwigi rhaniun menaw me ee?
Jacob we rhaepetomaem minne efang ngaenigemaem rhanniunim ee; iiy me aetekkewe naiun me naiun maan nge oanongeer nge re iun saengi rhan eei. Meeta, een wo iura pwe wo taegias saengi Jacob?”
Jesus a paniuwaeni, “Rhooakka re iun me reen rhan eei nge repwe moar sefaaen,

nge rhooa kena re iun me reen rhan na ngaang ipwe ngaenneer nge esooar faaen eew ne repwe moar. Rhan na ipwe ngaenneer ina epwene no pwe rhaepeton eew rhan ina epwene ngaenneer rhaniun menaw na esooar ssiaaenin.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Menap, ngaenneei aei rhan na! Ina nge isoapw rhiuwen moar no nge isoapw rhiuwen itto no igeei pwe ipwe itto ifiif rhan.”
Jesus a aengaeni, “Wonoa faingi mwaaen we rhooan ngaenne oamw nge wa sefaaeneto.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Esooar rhooan ngaenneaei.” Jesus a iura pwe, “Ennet minimwu wo iura pwe esooar rhooan ngaenne oamw.
Een wa moannon appwiuniupai ngaeniir nimman mwaaen, iwe nge mwaaen na wono reen igina ina soapw oanongonniuwan rhooan ngaenne oamw. Wo aengaeniaei minna wenewenen kkepas.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Iya weri pwe een erhai profeta, menap.
Re Samaria kkewe rhaepetoi re itto maeipin ngaeni Deus me wooan rhug eei, nge aaemi Jews oaw iura pwe Jerusalem minne sipwe maegin maeipin ngaeni Deus me ee.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Rhooapwut mwuun, niugiuniug ngaeniaei, eyor eew oat ina epwe noa itto nge aeremas resoapw maeipin ngaeni no minna Semaei me wooan rhug eei aere noan Jerusalem.
Aaemi re Samaria oawse giuneei iyo mwu oawgaen maeipin ngaeni; nge aemaem re Jews aei giuneei mane aeigaen maeipin ngaeni, pwe iga menaw na esooar ssiaaenin ina e itto me reer re Jews.
Nge oatona epwe itto ina a fasiun no igeei, reen minna maemaewaen Espritu Santus nge aeremas repwene maeipin ngaeni Deus, nge repwene feeori maeipin kkena e wenewen ina e tipaeni.
Deus ina ngeon, maemaewaen minne epwe mmwen pwe aeremas repwe maeipin ngaeni nge ina epwe noa reen Deus noan minna e wenewen.”
Rhooapwut we a iura pwe, “Ngaang i giuneei pwe Kristus epwe itto, oatona epwe itto, epwe aengaenigemaem oanongaen aegiaeg.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni, “Ngaang iiy minne i mwaenieniy ngaeniug.”

Oatonaan nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun Jesus ra sefaaen, nge iir ra igin riu pwe e mwaenieniy ngaeni erhai rhooapwut. Nge esooar erhai neeiir ne e aeiineow rhooapwut we, “Meeta wo tipaeni?” aere aeiyegiy Jesus pwe, “Meeta wo mwaenieniy ngaeni rhooapwut na reen?”
Rhooapwut we a nigiti ruumen rhan we aan, nge a sefaaen noa nee aepinoamw, nge a aengaeniir aeremas kkewe ee pwe,
“Oaw itto pipiiy mwaaen ee e aengaeniaei oanongaen meeta kkewe i feoffeeori. Oaw maengiy nge iiy minne Kristus?”
Iwe ra nigiti aepinoamw we nge ra noa reen Jesus.
Noan oatonaan nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe re iyaeffaenipirhe ngaeni Jesus pwe, “Sinsei, angi egiufet meeta!”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ngaang eyor aenaei mwongo ina aaemi oawse giuneei mmwenen.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra aeiyeg fengaen wooar, “Eyor mwo mane e pweipwog to mwongo reen?”
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Mwongo na aenaei ina ipwe tapweei tipaen manna efangeto ngaang, pwe ipwe oamoanna noa engaang na e ngaenneaei pwe ipwe feeori.
Eyor eew mwaeniaemi iwe oawgaen iura pwe, ‘Faawu rhag meram nge a oaton gin.’ Nge ipwe aengaenigaemi, oaw pipiiy gacchiuw maat kaan; foat kaan ikka a maaw pwe sipwene giniiy!
Iyo na a giniiy uwaen foat kaan ina a pwigi paniuwaen nge a ioni fengaenniy uwaen foat kaan pwe aegin menaw na esooar ssiaaenin; iwe iyo we efoat me iyo we egin nge repwe kker fengaen.
Pwe ennetaen kkepas we regaen iura pwe, ‘Erhai epwe foat nge erhai a giniiy uwaan.’
Iya fangenoa aaemi pwe oawpwe noa giniiy uwaen foat kena soapw foatogiyaemi; aaemweoi minne re engaang ee, nge aaemi oawwa pwigi wenepwuwaen aar engaang.”
Re towunap re Samaria kkewe reno noan aepinoamw we ra niugiuniug ngaeni Jesus pwe igiwe rhooapwut we e aengaeniir pwe, “E aengaeniaei oanongaen minikkewe iya moannon feoffeeori.”
Iwe re Samaria kkewe ra itto reen iwe ra aeffaenipirheei pwe epwe notiw reer, iwe Jesus a notiw reer noan riiuraaen.
Repwan towunap rhooakka re niugiuniug pwonno reen miniwe mwaenian,

ra aengaeni rhooapwut we pwe, “Aeiya niugiuniug igina, nge saapw igiwe wo aengaenigemaem, pwe iga aemaem wooan oanongaemmaem aeiya rongorong mwaenian, iwe aeiya giuneei pwe iiy miniwe rhooan aemenewa faeinaengiy.”
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Aetemwaaen
Mwirin aan no aegini riiuraaen igiwe, nge Jesus a nigiti iwe a noa Galilee.
Pwe iiy wooan oanongan miniwe e iura pwe, “Profeta nge esooar aesirowuur me noan sipegin faniuweer.”
Oatowe enoa toori Galilee, aeremas ra itto aewenimmwa, pwe igiwe renoa tapweei gupwunon Passover me Jerusalem, nge ra weri oanongaen minikkewe efeeori me reen gupwun we.
Iwe Jesus a sefaaen noa Cana me noan Galilee, pwiuneoi we efeeori rhaan pwe wine. Erhai aeremesaen aam eno ee nge mwaaen na naiun nge e semwaai me noan Capernaum.
Igiwe e rongorong pwe Jesus a itto me Judea pwe epwene noa Galilee, a noa reen nge a aengaeni pwe epwe noa mwo Capernaum pwe epwe noa aecchipwa aetena naiun, pwe epwene oaropaen mae.
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Esooar faaen eew ne erhai me neeimi epwe niugiuniug pwe aeggaen igine rhag eweri kkeman me min ariuriu.”
Aeremesaen aam we a iura pwe, “Menap, itto tapweaei weni mmwaen aetena naeyi epwe mae noa.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Wonoa, aetena noawumw epwene menaw!” Mwaaen we a niugiuniug ngaeni miniwe mwaeniaen Jesus iwe a noa.
A faaeraeg noa nge a noa rhuungiir slave kkewe nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Aetewe noawumw epwe menaw!”
A aeiineeor fitowu konook minne aetewe naiun etakketae. Iwe nge iir ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Epwe eew konook nee oanowesaen naeneew pwe iwe esa pwerhikkar no ginin.”
Iwe rhag nge miniwe semaen aetewe a maengiy noa pwe ina oatowe Jesus e aengaeni pwe, “Aetewe noawumw epwe menaw.” Iwe iiy me oanongeer rhooan famini we aan ra niugiuniug ngaeni.
A ieei minne oaruwowwaen kkeman Jesus a feeori weni mwirin aan itto me Judea ngaeni Galilee.
